rules.description: Applicant must be registered to vote
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be registered to vote before applying for a Voter Authority Certificate

rules.description: Applicant must be voting in England, Scotland or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for voters in England, Scotland and Wales only. Different rules apply in Northern Ireland.

rules.description: Applicant must lack accepted photo ID, or photo no longer looks like them, or name mismatch
rules.reason_if_failed: You only need a Voter Authority Certificate if you do not have accepted photo ID (passport, driving licence, certain bus passes)

rules.description: Applicant must provide National Insurance number OR alternative identity documents
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide either a National Insurance number or alternative documents (birth certificate, bank statement, utility bill) to prove your identity

rules.description: Applicant must provide a suitable digital photo
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide a digital photo that meets Electoral Commission requirements

edge_cases.description: Applicant does not have a National Insurance number
edge_cases.action: Route to alternative identity verification. Require birth certificate, bank statement and utility bill.

edge_cases.description: Applicant needs help taking a suitable digital photo
edge_cases.action: Hand off to electoral registration office for in-person photo assistance

edge_cases.description: Name on photo ID differs from electoral register
edge_cases.action: Inform applicant they can either re-register to vote with correct name, or take name change document to polling station. May still need VAC if photo ID is not accepted type.

edge_cases.description: Photo on existing ID no longer looks like applicant
edge_cases.action: Process VAC application to provide current photo ID

edge_cases.description: Applicant is registered as overseas voter
edge_cases.action: Overseas voters cannot vote in person at UK polling stations. Hand off to electoral registration office.
